meta.name: add-gmail-tool
meta.description: Add Gmail as an MCP tool (read, search, send, label, draft) using OneCLI-managed OAuth. The agent gets Gmail tools in every enabled group; OneCLI injects real tokens at request time so no raw credentials are ever in the container or on disk in usable form.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 MCP 工具读取、搜索、发送和管理 Gmail 邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 agent 中集成 Gmail 功能，且不想手动处理 OAuth 凭证。
copy.tagline_en: Read, search, send, and manage Gmail emails via MCP tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to integrate Gmail into your agent without handling OAuth credentials manually.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取、搜索、发送、标记和草拟 Gmail 邮件，通过 MCP 工具实现。
howto.when: 当你在已启用该技能的对话中要求 Claude 操作 Gmail（如“列出我的标签”）时触发。

say.text: 列出我的 Gmail 标签
搜索上个月的发票邮件
给张三发一封邮件，主题是会议提醒
say.note: Claude 会调用 send_email 工具发送邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read, search, send, label, and draft Gmail emails via MCP tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to perform Gmail operations (e.g., "list my labels") in a conversation where the skill is enabled.

say_en.note: Claude will call the list_labels tool and return the label list.

say_en.text: Search my inbox for invoices from last month
say_en.note: Claude will call the search_emails tool to search the inbox.

say_en.text: Send an email to John with subject 'Meeting reminder'
say_en.note: Claude will call the send_email tool to send the email.
